Yuichi was a great guide and very patient. Unfortunately, our flight had gotten delayed by 10 hours and we landed into Tokyo much later than expected. We had significant jet lag coming from the east coast. It was also pouring raining. Despite all this, Yuichi took us around Tokyo the next day. 

I would recommend this type of tour for those who are looking for a quick hit of alot of the highlights in Tokyo. Tokyo is just too big of a city to be able to comfortably see it all. We were looking to be able to see all of the major spots quickly so that we could get an idea of where to focus our trip over the next several days. We had only planned to be in Tokyo for 7 days. Using the metro system, it can take 40 minutes to get from the west side to east side or vice versa. It was incredibly helpful to have Yuichi show us around the metro. We went from Shinjuku/Shibuya to as far east as the Skytree. It made for a very long day but it was very helpful for us to plan for a successful trip. This can also be personalized and I am sure Yuichi would help to keep it more focused or shorter depending on needs. But I would strongly recommend for those who want to get a quick hit of all the highlights.
